description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OEE"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/oee">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StopCommand" name="Stop machine"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_EngineerEmail" name="OEE alert email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OEE">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OEE" name="OEE Process" processRef="Process_OEE"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Machine" name="Machine"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Engineer" name="Engineer"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StopCommand" name="Stop machine" sourceRef="SendTask_StopMachine" targetRef="Participant_Machine" messageRef="Msg_StopCommand"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EngineerEmail" name="OEE alert email" sourceRef="SendTask_EmailEngineer" targetRef="Participant_Engineer" messageRef="Msg_EngineerEmail"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_MachineRestarted" messageRef="Msg_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="StartEvent_MachineDisconnected" messageRef="Msg_MachineDisconnected"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Measure" name="Start measuring">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Cycle_Merge" name="Measurement cycle">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Restart_ToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OEE_OK_ToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_ToConnCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Connected_Split" name="Machine connected?" default="Flow_Connected_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_ToConnCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Connected_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Connected_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessStopped" name="Process stopped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Connected_No</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_RetrieveAvailability" name="Retrieve availability data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Connected_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Avail_ToPerf</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_RetrievePerformance" name="Retrieve performance data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Avail_ToPerf</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Perf_ToQuality</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_RetrieveQuality" name="Retrieve quality data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Perf_ToQuality</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Quality_ToCalculate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Quality_ToCalculate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Calculate_ToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEE_Split" name="OEE below threshold?" default="Flow_OEE_OK_ToMerge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Calculate_ToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OEE_OK_ToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OEE_Below</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_StopMachine" name="Stop machine" messageRef="Msg_StopCommand">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OEE_Below</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stop_ToEmail</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_EmailEngineer" name="Send email to engineer" messageRef="Msg_EngineerEmail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stop_ToEmail</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email_ToWait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email_ToWait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Restart_ToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_MachineRestarted" messageRef="Msg_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ToMerge" sourceRef="StartEvent_Measure" targetRef="Gateway_Cycle_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_ToConnCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_Cycle_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Connected_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Connected_Yes" name="Connected" sourceRef="Gateway_Connected_Split" targetRef="ServiceTask_RetrieveAvailability">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${machineConnected == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Connected_No" name="Not connected" sourceRef="Gateway_Connected_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Avail_ToPerf" sourceRef="ServiceTask_RetrieveAvailability" targetRef="ServiceTask_RetrievePerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Perf_ToQuality" sourceRef="ServiceTask_RetrievePerformance" targetRef="ServiceTask_RetrieveQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quality_ToCalculate" sourceRef="ServiceTask_RetrieveQuality" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_ToSplit" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_OEE_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_OK_ToMerge" name="OEE acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Cycle_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_Below" name="OEE below threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Split" targetRef="SendTask_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${oee < oeeThreshold}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_ToEmail" sourceRef="SendTask_StopMachine" targetRef="SendTask_EmailEngineer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_ToWait" sourceRef="SendTask_EmailEngineer" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restart_ToMerge" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_MachineRestarted" targetRef="Gateway_Cycle_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disconnected_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_MachineDisconnected" messageRef="Msg_MachineDisconnected"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessTerminated" name="Process stopped">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disconnected_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="TED_ProcessTerminated"/>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected_ToEnd" sourceRef="StartEvent_MachineDisconnected" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessTerminated"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
